column1: # shortMnistForCI per-iteration figures against released orthotope.
# Taken 2026-08-28 on GHC 9.12.4 at -A32m -I0, ox-arrays 0.2.0.1, and RELEASED
# orthotope 0.1.8.0 from Hackage (cabal.project.local's packages: ../orthotope
# commented out; verified in the build plan as style=global, src=repo-tar), so
# this is the anchor that does not move while the orthotope PR branch churns,
# and the one comparable with CI, which resolves orthotope from Hackage too.
# Do not diff a sibling-checkout collection against this file: the benchmark
# names match, so the tool would report the difference as movement rather than
# as a mismatched reference. bench/baseline-convvjp.tsv is the checkout one.
# bytes_per_iter is the allocated-vs-iters OLS slope and is exact (every fit
# here R2 1.000000); it is the instrument. seconds_per_iter carries the machine
# and the roster, which the position effect moves up to 10%
# (docs/position-effect.md), so a time difference under that is not evidence.
# benchmark\tseconds_per_iter\tbytes_per_iter
